pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/1574 and cleans up `System.Net.Http.Json` to use the new sync methods instead of the `Utf8JsonWriter` workaround.

Also some test refactoring to enable calling the new sync-based methods along with the existing async methods.
pr_comments:
Note regarding the `new-api-needs-documentation` label:

This serves as a reminder for when your PR is modifying a ref *.cs file and adding/modifying public APIs, to please make sure the API implementation in the src *.cs file is documented with triple slash comments, so the PR reviewers can sign off that change.

Tagging subscribers to this area: @eiriktsarpalis, @layomia See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.

review_comments:
nit: for consistency with other read/write helpers that use `JsonTypeInfo` (or remove suffix from the existing ones)
```suggestion
        internal static TValue? ReadAllUsingMetadata<TValue>(
```

Hmm I think removing suffix is better - otherwise we'd have "ReadAllUsingMetadataAsync" which is a little verbose, plus the "Metadata" nomenclature is lost right after that (everything becomes metadata-based at runtime).
It doesn't need to be since that was declared elsewhere. However, I'll make a new StreamTests.cs and declaring it there.
